title: A Global Euro Must First Win Over Europe
summary: In a world of competing currency blocs, the euro is the dollar’s most credible rival. But for it to become a genuine counterweight to the greenback, the European Union must strengthen its financial foundations and expand its reach, starting with the member states that have not adopted it despite being obliged to do so.

title: Japan Needs Higher Interest Rates
summary: In 2012, when Japan was dealing with chronic deflation, policymakers were right to embrace monetary easing, including lower interest rates. Today, however, Japan faces the opposite problem: a weak yen, combined with higher interest rates in the US, calls for a much tighter monetary policy.

title: From AI Boom to Economic Bust
summary: Contrary to tech optimists' rosy predictions, AI may prove to be a drag on growth. By concentrating wealth and economic opportunities in a few cities while destroying the low-cost jobs that have historically fueled global development, the technology could end up making much of the world poorer and more divided.
